name: Слабо расслышанная реплика: отменимое делается, неотменимое придерживается
_: Both halves of the rule the run of 22.09.2026 forced. The score is the model's opinion of its own transcription and it is NOT a gate on the auction: a subscriber that recognised its phrase is believed when the action can be taken back, and is still held back when it cannot. minUtteranceScore in speechbroker-host.json is 0.40, so 0.10 is well under it.

steps._: reversible: test.doors recognises it and acts, low score and all
expensive: the spell must NOT go off on an utterance heard this badly
